wasm_notes: -D_GNU_SOURCE (sched_setscheduler/sched_setaffinity no-ops now come from compat/include/schwung_module_prelude.h): the worker thread calls sched_setscheduler/sched_setaffinity (demote from SCHED_FIFO, keep off core 3). musl only declares them under _GNU_SOURCE, and Emscripten's libc omits musl src/sched entirely, so without the hidden-visibility no-op stubs the worker traps on an unresolved import. Organ is built on the init worker; silent until `ready`, so the test needs realtime pacing (test.realtime, not yet implemented by testhost). Verified audible (-20.6 dBFS rms) with a paced host, default and threaded.
